title: Complete release content projection for release 1.7.0

path.description: Canonical package-root-relative POSIX member path under Core's material path rules.

metadata.description: Descriptive data only. It confers no effect, authority or required evidence.

targets.description: Client ids the set suits. Only narrows what is offered; never binds delivery.

item.description: A member of the set's own framework names framework and itemId. A member of another framework is also pinned by releaseVersion, contentSha256 and behaviourSha256.

set_setRef.description: releaseVersion is present exactly when the set is in another release.

set_option.description: A pick-several choice; each choice maps to sets. always applies whether or not a choice is made.

materials.description: Ascending content material ids: exactly this recipe's material closure.

inputs.description: Ascending input names of the item this recipe defines.

recipes.description: Transition recipes of the replaced tool variants, selected by clientId.

releaseContent.title: Catalog release with one tool-neutral item per piece of content
releaseContent.description: Closed kinds, a presentation role, required behaviour files and both identities, supersession, durable retirement, embedded sets and an optional transition recipe map selected by clientId. Readers older than 1.7.0 refuse the whole format. Like release 1.5 and 1.6, the release carries its baseline binding.
